samples.bn: আনতাম: স্বীক্রিকেল এপ্রিয়েজ: যہदুন্দোগে, आपकা ঘরে अफसरশীত होने में 10-খালी বিষয়ক खतर হै। 2.2 ওয়গুন্দোগে Char Bandar Primary School Shelter (সরকারী পশ্ত) মার্केबল, বিষয় অবস্যার হࡋে 2.04 ওয়গুন্দোগে। Access road Village Access Road 1 will be cut off soonest within an hour of this alert being issued, so it is crucial to evacuate immediately without delaying for livests or heavy furniture carrying.

samples.en: Urgent: Your home is at CRITICAL risk of flooding in just an hour with the Village Access Road becoming impassable soon afterward (1 km away). Immediately head for Char Bandar Primary School Shelter. Prioritize leaving over saving possessions, pack essential items like ID documents and medicine only if time allows before evacuation.
